artifacts.summary: Seven-phase plan closing the idle-past half and the unconditional join of the ladder-path region interface: an anchor-free lift, the region-start extraction, the inserted walk's region-start trichotomy, hpins, both existentials under an explicit path-local self-loop, records, and the full gate.

memory_candidates.content: When a planned construction is described in the source records as needing an ITERATION (a cascade, a doubling recurrence) over a family of constraints that all shift together, check whether a single move at the family's own anchor point discharges all of them at once. In the ladder-path insertion case (FormalSystem/Metalogic/Decidability/RaySummary/LadderAgree.lean), the recorded mechanism anticipated inserting idle positions into each idle run in turn, with the displacement propagating down as the recurrence cascadeDemand encodes. Taking the insertion site to be the region start of the SURGERY'S OWN region instead moves every earlier region start down by the same amount together: their mutual distances are preserved and only their distance to the one raised pin grows, so a single insertion of depth equal to the lengthening discharges the whole pin family exactly. The general pattern: an iteration is owed only when the moves interfere; when a single move is uniform over the whole affected family, the recurrence is a sizing record rather than live machinery. Second instance of the same shape: an anchor side condition (hn0) over a pairwise-compatible family is often eliminable by applying the family's own extension lemma (a McShane/Lipschitz extension) and reading the anchor off the extension, rather than constructed case by case.
